pages.title: Life Star
pages.text: §c§lAcquisition: §r Complete the ritual at the altar.$(br2)The base is a 7×7 area of natural blocks that can support plants (grass blocks, dirt, nylium, farmland, etc.).$(br2)Place an Enchanted Golden Apple in the center, any flower at the four corners (Wither Rose excluded), and Glistering Melon Slices at the midpoints of the four edges.$(br2)§lCondition: §r Works while in a Curios slot, or in the main hand / off hand.$(br2)Bountiful Breath: max health increases to 100; healing speed is increased fivefold; hunger and saturation no longer drain.$(br)Morning Dew: deals an extra 10% physical damage based on your max health.$(br)Last Light: when you would take lethal damage, clears all negative effects and restores 75% of your health.$(br)Camellia Revival: when your health drops below 50%, restores 33% of your max health.$(br)Nourishing Rain: recovers 1.5 health every 60 ticks while it rains; applies to creatures tamed by the player as well.

pages.name: Life Star Altar
pages.text: The grass blocks shown are only an example; any natural block that can support plants may be used.

§lPlacement:§r$(br2)Center: Enchanted Golden Apple$(br)Four corners: any flower (Wither Rose excluded)$(br)Midpoints of the four edges: Glistering Melon Slice$(br2)Once placed, right-click any display pedestal to begin the ritual.
